#!/bin/sh
# Boot Alpine ISO in QEMU with serial console on a TCP socket (port 4555),
# SSH host-forwarded to host port 2222. No graphical display.
set -e
pkill -f 'qemu-system-x86_64' 2>/dev/null || true
sleep 1
cd /app
nohup qemu-system-x86_64 \
  -m 1024 -smp 2 \
  -cdrom /app/alpine.iso \
  -drive file=/app/alpine-disk.qcow2,format=qcow2,if=virtio \
  -boot d \
  -netdev user,id=net0,hostfwd=tcp::2222-:22 \
  -device virtio-net-pci,netdev=net0 \
  -display none \
  -serial tcp:127.0.0.1:4555,server,nowait \
  > /app/.stella/vmrun/qemu.stdout 2> /app/.stella/vmrun/qemu.stderr &
echo "qemu launched, pid $!"
sleep 2
echo "--- qemu.stderr ---"
cat /app/.stella/vmrun/qemu.stderr 2>/dev/null || true

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Drive the Alpine guest over the serial console:
- wait for login prompt, log in as root (no password)
- bring up networking (DHCP on eth0)
- generate SSH host keys
- configure sshd: PermitRootLogin yes, PasswordAuthentication yes
- set root password to 'password123'
- start sshd
- verify sshd is listening on port 22 inside the guest
"""
import sys
import time
sys.path.insert(0, "/app/.stella/vmrun")
from console_driver import Console

c = Console()
PASSWORD = "password123"


def run(cmd, prompt="localhost:~#", timeout=60):
    """Send a command, wait for the shell prompt, return elapsed."""
    c.reset_buffer()
    c.sendline(cmd)
    ok, el = c.expect(prompt, timeout=timeout)
    if not ok:
        snap = c.snapshot()
        print(f"[!] TIMEOUT ({el:.0f}s) waiting for prompt after: {cmd!r}", flush=True)
        print("---- buffer tail ----", flush=True)
        print(snap[-1500:], flush=True)
        sys.exit(1)
    print(f"[+] {cmd}  ({el:.0f}s)", flush=True)
    return el


def main():
    # 1. Wait for the login prompt
    print("[*] waiting for login prompt...", flush=True)
    ok, el = c.expect("login:", timeout=180)
    print(f"    login prompt seen: {ok} ({el:.0f}s)", flush=True)
    if not ok:
        print(c.snapshot()[-1500:], flush=True)
        sys.exit(1)

    # 2. Log in as root (no password on the ISO)
    c.sendline("root")
    ok, el = c.expect("localhost:~#", timeout=60)
    # Some Alpine prompts: 'localhost:~#' or just '#'. Accept a '#' fallback.
    if not ok:
        ok2, el2 = c.expect("#", timeout=10)
        if not ok2:
            print("[!] did not get shell prompt after login", flush=True)
            print(c.snapshot()[-1500:], flush=True)
            sys.exit(1)
    print(f"[+] logged in as root ({el:.0f}s)", flush=True)
    time.sleep(1)

    # 3. Reliable marker prompt so we can detect command completion robustly.
    #    Set PS1 to a unique marker.
    c.sendline("export PS1='STELLA##'")
    ok, el = c.expect("STELLA##", timeout=30)
    if not ok:
        print("[!] could not set PS1", flush=True)
        print(c.snapshot()[-1000:], flush=True)
        sys.exit(1)
    MARK = "STELLA##"

    # 4. Bring up networking: set eth0 up + DHCP. udhcpc is available on the live ISO.
    run("ip link set eth0 up", prompt=MARK, timeout=20)
    run("udhcpc -i eth0 -q -t 10 -n 2>&1 | tail -3", prompt=MARK, timeout=45)
    run("ip -4 addr show eth0 | grep inet || echo NO_IP", prompt=MARK, timeout=15)

    # 5. Generate SSH host keys (live ISO does not ship them).
    run("ssh-keygen -A 2>&1 | tail -2", prompt=MARK, timeout=40)

    # 6. Configure sshd to allow root login with a password.
    run("sed -i 's/^#\\?PermitRootLogin.*/PermitRootLogin yes/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config", prompt=MARK, timeout=15)
    run("sed -i 's/^#\\?PasswordAuthentication.*/PasswordAuthentication yes/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config", prompt=MARK, timeout=15)
    # Ensure the directive is present (append if sed found nothing to replace)
    run("grep -q '^PermitRootLogin yes' /etc/ssh/sshd_config || echo 'PermitRootLogin yes' >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config", prompt=MARK, timeout=15)
    run("grep -q '^PasswordAuthentication yes' /etc/ssh/sshd_config || echo 'PasswordAuthentication yes' >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config", prompt=MARK, timeout=15)

    # 7. Set root password.
    c.reset_buffer()
    c.sendline("passwd root")
    ok, el = c.expect("New password:", timeout=15)
    if not ok:
        print("[!] passwd did not prompt for new password", flush=True)
        print(c.snapshot()[-1000:], flush=True)
        sys.exit(1)
    c.sendline(PASSWORD)
    ok, el = c.expect("Retype", timeout=15)
    if not ok:
        # maybe different prompt
        ok, el = c.expect("password:", timeout=10)
    c.sendline(PASSWORD)
    ok, el = c.expect(MARK, timeout=15)
    print(f"[+] root password set ({el:.0f}s)", flush=True)

    # 8. Start sshd. First kill any existing, then start.
    run("killall sshd 2>/dev/null || true", prompt=MARK, timeout=15)
    run("/usr/sbin/sshd", prompt=MARK, timeout=20)
    # Verify it is listening
    run("netstat -ltn 2>/dev/null | grep ':22 ' || ss -ltn 2>/dev/null | grep ':22' || echo CHECKING_SSHD", prompt=MARK, timeout=15)
    # Also confirm sshd config parses
    run("/usr/sbin/sshd -t && echo SSHD_CONFIG_OK", prompt=MARK, timeout=15)

    print("[*] setup driver complete.", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Reconnect to the running Alpine guest's serial console and run a sequence
of commands, printing the REAL captured output (not just the prompt).
"""
import sys
import time
sys.path.insert(0, "/app/.stella/vmrun")
from console_driver import Console

c = Console(logpath="/app/.stella/vmrun/sertrace2.log")
MARK = "STELLA##"


def run(cmd, timeout=90):
    """Send cmd, wait for MARK, print captured output. Returns output text."""
    c.reset_buffer()
    c.sendline(cmd)
    ok, el = c.expect(MARK, timeout=timeout)
    out = c.snapshot()
    # strip the echoed command and trailing marker for readability
    print(f"\n--- $ {cmd}   ({el:.0f}s, ok={ok}) ---", flush=True)
    print(out, flush=True)
    if not ok:
        print("[!] TIMEOUT", flush=True)
    return out


def main():
    # Poke the console: send a newline and wait for our marker (set in prior session).
    c.sendline("")
    ok, el = c.expect(MARK, timeout=15)
    if not ok:
        # maybe prompt is different; try to set it
        c.sendline("export PS1='STELLA##'")
        ok2, el2 = c.expect(MARK, timeout=15)
        print(f"[*] marker present: {ok} / reset: {ok2}", flush=True)
    else:

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Configure and start sshd in the Alpine guest, then verify it's listening."""
import sys
import time
sys.path.insert(0, "/app/.stella/vmrun")
from console_driver import Console

c = Console(logpath="/app/.stella/vmrun/sertrace3.log")
MARK = "STELLA##"
PASSWORD = "password123"


def run(cmd, timeout=60):
    c.reset_buffer()
    c.sendline(cmd)
    ok, el = c.expect(MARK, timeout=timeout)
    out = c.snapshot()
    print(f"\n--- $ {cmd}   ({el:.0f}s, ok={ok}) ---", flush=True)
    print(out, flush=True)
    return out


def main():
    c.sendline("")
    ok, el = c.expect(MARK, timeout=15)
    print(f"[*] marker present: {ok}", flush=True)

    # 1. Generate host keys
    run("ssh-keygen -A 2>&1", timeout=60)

    # 2. Configure sshd: allow root login + password auth.
    run("sed -i 's/^#\\?PermitRootLogin.*/PermitRootLogin yes/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config", timeout=15)
    run("sed -i 's/^#\\?PasswordAuthentication.*/PasswordAuthentication yes/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config", timeout=15)
    run("grep -q '^PermitRootLogin yes' /etc/ssh/sshd_config || echo 'PermitRootLogin yes' >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config", timeout=15)
    run("grep -q '^PasswordAuthentication yes' /etc/ssh/sshd_config || echo 'PasswordAuthentication yes' >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config", timeout=15)

    # Show effective config (non-comment lines)
    run("grep -E '^(PermitRootLogin|PasswordAuthentication) ' /etc/ssh/sshd_config", timeout=15)

    # 3. Validate config
    run("/usr/sbin/sshd -t && echo SSHD_CONFIG_OK", timeout=15)

    # 4. Start sshd (kill any stale one first)
    run("killall sshd 2>/dev/null; /usr/sbin/sshd && echo SSHD_STARTED", timeout=20)

    # 5. Verify it is listening on 22
    run("(netstat -ltn 2>/dev/null || ss -ltn 2>/dev/null) | grep ':22'", timeout=15)

    # 6. Confirm password is still set (re-set to be safe)
    c.reset_buffer()
    c.sendline("passwd root")
    ok, el = c.expect("New password:", timeout=15)
    print(f"[*] passwd prompt: {ok} ({el:.0f}s)", flush=True)
    c.sendline(PASSWORD)
    ok, el = c.expect("Retype", timeout=15)
    c.sendline(PASSWORD)
    ok, el = c.expect(MARK, timeout=15)
    print(f"[+] root password re-set ({el:.0f}s)", flush=True)

    print("\n[*] guest configuration complete.", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
